# Architecture Decision Records Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that ADRs are complete, approved, consistent with the plan and specification, and traceable
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is an ADR present for each of the 16 required decision areas, or a justified "no ADR needed" recorded? [Completeness, docs/adr/README] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does every ADR contain all required sections in order, including the five consequence categories? [Completeness, docs/adr/ADR-001..027] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Does every ADR compare at least two options with advantages, disadvantages, risks, impact, and assessment implications? [Completeness, Constitution VII] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does every ADR state reversibility and a validation approach that is an executable or reviewable check? [Measurability, docs/adr/ADR-001..027] [M, G0]

## Status and Approval

- [ ] CHK005 - Is every Accepted ADR backed by a Decision Record entry naming it, and none Accepted without explicit human approval? [Traceability, Spec DEC-071..094, DEC-107..109] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Do the DEC ids cited in each ADR status match the specification's Decision Record rows? [Consistency, Spec DEC-103] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are amendments to accepted ADRs recorded with the amending DEC and reflected in the ADR text? [Consistency, ADR-001, ADR-003, ADR-007, ADR-015, ADR-023] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the rejected-first-version trail kept for ADR-003, ADR-014, and ADR-025? [Traceability, Spec DEC-095..097] [O, G0]

## Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 - Do ADR numeric values (retry bounds, lease, retention, pool size, code length) match their approved sources? [Consistency, Spec PVT-009, DEC-030, DEC-031, DEC-113] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Do the ADRs and research.md agree, with docs/adr declared authoritative and divergences listed? [Consistency, Spec DEC-106] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK011 - Does ADR-014's relationship to the constitution's four outcomes and to FR-128's wording appear as a recorded conflict or resolution? [Conflict, ADR-014, Spec FR-128] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Do accepted ADRs avoid contradicting approved decisions (DEC-034 atomicity versus Redis), with the resolution documented? [Consistency, ADR-015, ADR-026] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is each residual risk in an ADR linked to the plan's risk register or the security residual list? [Traceability, Plan §8, Security §6] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Does each ADR map to requirement IDs, spec sections, plan sections, and tasks (or state "not yet generated")? [Traceability, docs/adr/ADR-001..027] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are unresolved items inside accepted ADRs (image tags, metadata characters) each given an owner and decision point? [Completeness, docs/adr/README] [M, G0]

## Change and Drift

- [ ] CHK016 - Does a material post-acceptance architectural change require a new or superseding ADR, with a failure condition when code diverges from an accepted ADR? [Coverage, Constitution VII, POL-ARCH-002] [M, G0] {Detects: undocumented-architecture-drift}
- [ ] CHK017 - Is a superseding-ADR procedure (status, DEC, link to the superseded record) defined? [Gap, Spec DEC-103] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
